10.label: Gem Mint
10.description: A virtually perfect card. Attributes include four perfectly sharp corners, sharp focus, and full original gloss. A PSA Gem Mint 10 must be free of staining, and exhibit only the slightest white on corners under magnification.
10.surface: No print spots, color or focus imperfections

9.label: Mint
9.description: A superb condition card that exhibits only one of the following minor flaws: a very slight wax stain on reverse, a minor printing imperfection, or slightly off-white borders.
9.corners: Four sharp corners with a hint of white

8.label: Near Mint-Mint
8.description: A super high-end card that appears Mint 9 at first glance, but upon closer inspection, the card can exhibit the following: a slight wax stain on the back, minimal fraying at the corners, slight loss of original gloss, or a minor print line.
8.edges: Minor chipping visible to naked eye
8.surface: Minor surface wear, light scratches possible

7.label: Near Mint
7.description: A card with just a slight surface wear visible upon close inspection. There may be slight fraying on some corners. Picture focus may be slightly out-of-register. A minor print line is acceptable.
7.surface: Slight surface wear, focus slightly off

6.label: Excellent-Mint
6.description: A card with visible surface wear or a printing defect which does not detract from its overall appeal. A very light scratch may be detected only upon close inspection.

5.label: Excellent
5.description: A card with obvious surface wear but no creases or bends. Centering must be 80/20 or better on the front and 90/10 or better on the back.

4.label: Very Good-Excellent
4.description: A card that has more corner wear than a PSA EX 5, but no creases. Centering must be 85/15 or better on the front and 90/10 or better on the back.

3.label: Very Good
3.description: A card that shows obvious handling. The corners may show advanced wearing and rounding, and the borders may be somewhat yellowed.

2.label: Good
2.description: A well-worn card with creases, heavy staining, and heavy rounding on corners. A card graded Good 2 might be heavily trimmed.

1.label: Poor
1.description: A card with miscuts, heavy creasing, holes, and major stains. May also have a missing piece.

10.label: Pristine
10.description: The highest grade. A virtually flawless card in every way.

9.5.label: Gem Mint
9.5.description: The highest commonly issued grade. Extraordinary card.
9.5.subgrades_required: All subgrades must be 9.5 or higher for Black Label

9.label: Mint
9.description: A superb card with only minor imperfections.

8.5.label: Near Mint-Mint+
8.5.description: An excellent card with minor flaws.

8.label: Near Mint-Mint
8.description: A great card with visible minor wear.

7.label: Near Mint
7.description: A card with visible wear on one or more attributes.

9.label: Mint
9.description: Near perfect signature with minor placement issue

7.label: Near Mint
7.description: Good signature with some fading or smearing

6.label: Excellent-Mint
6.description: Signature shows wear or poor placement
